propositions: The completion verifier returns non-deterministic verdicts (PASS vs FAIL) for identical inputs across multiple runs within minutes with no code changes, making the close gate unreliable for both blocking legitimate completions and passing incomplete ones.

The verifier's test-existence judgment fails non-deterministically because it uses free-form variable search strategies (semantic/regex queries that miss literal substrings and ticket-ids) rather than deterministic lookup by exact symbol or exhaustive listing.

The COMPLETION_VERDICT sidecar lacks diagnosability fields (verified_at_sha, trace_id, model settings) needed to prove whether non-determinism stems from input drift or LLM sampling variance when reviewing persisted records.

Pinning model temperature to 0 (greedy decoding) by default in _verify_completion_inner while allowing explicit REBAR_LLM_TEMPERATURE override reduces sampling variance and mirrors the plan-review verifier's determinism mitigation.

Recording verified_at_sha and trace_id in both PASS and FAIL completion sidecar payloads via build_payload enables future debugging of verifier non-determinism by proving input identity from stored data alone.
